title: admission pipeline emits the three canonical rejection reasons with matching wire contracts across all six SDKs
documentation_only_reason: The six declared admission integration tests execute this stateful contract because the generic pure-vector runners do not own a LocalRuntime. Every declared test must load this file and assert its expect block; documentation_only is a runner classification, not an evidence exemption.
overview: Every DescriptorBoundInvocationRequest runs four sequential checks before the envelope is allowed to transition to Admitted: (1) validate_envelope, (2) validate_signature_structure, (3) descriptor-bound caller-signature verification through a required KeyResolver, (4) nonce-replay check. The first failure rejects; the envelope does not progress and no admitted receipt is emitted.
pipeline_order: validate_signature_structure  // always on, MUST precede replay-store insert
verify_descriptor_bound_signature  // always on through the runtime's required KeyResolver
check_nonce_replay        // always on; key = (caller.ura, ability, invocation_nonce)

trigger_examples: invocation_nonce is all zero (2^-128 CSPRNG accident vs uninitialised-field mistake)
AXON_AXIOM_ENVELOPE_INCOMPLETE.message_format: granular sub-reason string (e.g. `ability_empty`, `invocation_nonce_all_zero`) in the AxonError.message field for operator visibility; `reason` stays the canonical ALLCAPS constant.

trigger_examples: signature fails crypto verify against resolver-supplied public key
AXON_CALLER_SIGNATURE_INVALID.message_format: sub-reason (`signature_algorithm_empty`, `ed25519_signature_wrong_length`, `unsupported_algorithm:<id>`, or the wrapped axiom-layer error text) in message.

trigger_examples: the tuple (caller.ura, ability, nonce) was observed within the current dedup window

trust_model.name: provider_backed
trust_model.checks_run: full four-step pipeline including cryptographic caller verification
trust_model.missing_resolver: reject with AXON_CALLER_SIGNATURE_INVALID before replay-store mutation
trust_model.rationale: A LocalRuntime is an admission authority, not the caller that just signed. Same-process placement does not permit self-asserted identity or a second local-fast authority model.

replay_store_contract.ability_in_key_rationale: A legitimate (caller, nonce) reused across two distinct abilities MUST NOT be misdedup'd. Review feedback required this.
replay_store_contract.window_ms_default_rationale: 7 days — correctness/idempotency guard, not a security counter. Operators can tune via set_admission_dedup_window_ms(ms).
replay_store_contract.pollution_invariant: Malformed envelopes and malformed signatures MUST NOT enter the replay store. Pipeline ordering (envelope → structure → verify → replay) enforces this; each SDK has a dedicated test asserting the replay store size stays 0 after an early-stage reject.
replay_store_contract.persistence: Week-3 scope is per-runtime in-memory. Week-5+ swaps for a WAL-backed store with the production runtime's durability contract.

configuration_contract.resolver_lifecycle: required before public dispatch; no clear-to-local-fast operation
configuration_contract.dedup_window: operator-configurable without changing the authority model

notes: The actual assertions are per-SDK because AxonError shapes and test harnesses differ. Each declared test loads this JSON and proves the same request, resolver, rejection, ordering, and replay invariants.

When changing the RFC §5.2 wire contract (adding a new rejection reason, changing a reason literal, or reordering the pipeline), every SDK's admission test must be updated in the same commit, and this JSON must be updated to describe the new shape. A divergence here is a spec bug.

consumers.loader_rule: This critical vector is not optional. The listed tests are the release-blocking consumers for the contract pinned here.
